# AL1402: [TrimSafe] code must not call methods with [RequiresUnreferencedCode]

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/ANcpLua.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Warning |
| Category | `AOT Testing` |

| Analyzer | `Al1402TrimSafeViolationAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

Code marked with [TrimSafe] guarantees it will work correctly in trimmed applications. Calling methods with [RequiresUnreferencedCode] violates this guarantee because those methods may fail at runtime when types are trimmed.
